newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open lower.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open lower.

text.p: New York precious metals futures were called to open lower Thursday, after renewed weakness in the bullion market in Asia and Europe on further rumors of central bank selling.
Spot gold bounced back Wednesday from a three-year low posted Tuesday of $366.00 an ounce.
COMEX February gold was called $1.00 to $2.00 from Wednesday's close of $372.50 after trading down to $369.50 on ACCESS.
Spot gold was quoted at $368.90/369.40 in early New York trade, after fixing at $368.30 in London this morning.
COMEX gold stocks fell 56,528 ounces Wednesday to 1,055,677 ounces.
COMEX March silver was called down 3.0 to 5.0 cents from Wednesday's close of $4.862 after trading down to $4.770 on ACCESS.
COMEX silver stocks rose 135,055 ounces Wednesday to 148,455,705 ounces.
NYMEX January platinum was called off $0.30 to $0.50 from the prior close of $378.20, with NYMEX March palladium called $0.20 to $0.30 weaker from Wednesday's close of $118.75.
